introduced.how: self-introduction as Astrologist Mona Megistus
introduced.name: Mona Megistus
introduced.quote: Mona: I am Astrologist Mona Megistus. But considering that it is most rude to misremember names, I allow others to call me Mona.

introduced.how: master's box to retrieve from Mondstadt
introduced.name: Box
introduced.quote: Mona: I am on a mission from my master to retrieve a certain box from Mondstadt.

introduced.how: agreement made with friend 50 years ago
introduced.name: 50-year agreement
introduced.quote: Mona: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago. But she isn't as spry as she used to be, so it's now up to me.

introduced.how: astrology reads stars via water reflections
introduced.name: Astrology
introduced.quote: Mona: My astrology is based on hydromancy, and as the name suggests, I use the reflections in water bodies to observe the true starry sky.

introduced.how: inn owner who lost ring to slime
introduced.name: Mr. Zhu
introduced.quote: Mr. Zhu: Mona, you've come at just the right time. Did you see a jade ring while you made your way here?

introduced.how: heirloom ring swallowed by slime
introduced.name: Nephrite Ring
introduced.quote: Mr. Zhu: Oh, that's not good... that ring was given to me by my mother. But while my back was turned, it was swallowed up by a slime!

introduced.how: bait that lures nearby slimes
introduced.name: Elemental Bait
introduced.quote: Paimon: Hmm, since it was swallowed up by a slime, maybe we can use Elemental Bait to lure all the nearby slimes to us.

introduced.how: currency paid as compensation
introduced.name: Mora
introduced.quote: Mr. Zhu: *sigh* Well, I was going to put up twenty thousand Mora as compensation, if you were willing.

introduced.how: waitress taking orders at Wangshu Inn
introduced.name: Yuhua
introduced.quote: Yuhua: Excuse me, what would you like to order?

introduced.how: large shrimp wrapped in crispy-fried potatoes
introduced.name: Golden Shrimp Balls
introduced.quote: Yuhua: These are made using large, succulent shrimp wrapped in crispy-fried potatoes. They have an amazing texture.

introduced.how: vegetarian imitation of abalone
introduced.name: Vegetarian Abalone
introduced.quote: Yuhua: It's exactly what it says on the label — abalone made from vegetarian ingredients. It's just as good as the real thing!

introduced.how: tofu paired with crab roe specialty
introduced.name: Crab Roe Tofu
introduced.quote: Yuhua: Though tofu could not be a more ordinary ingredient, it and crab roe are truly a match made in heaven. It's one of our specialties.

introduced.how: soup of bamboo shoots meat and ham
introduced.name: Salted Pork Soup
introduced.quote: Yuhua: This is a favorite among our regulars. Bamboo shoots, meat and ham are cooked together, creating a richly-flavored soup.

introduced.how: flour-crusted crab fried with ginger and garlic
introduced.name: Golden Crab
introduced.quote: Huai'an: It's crab meat that's been rolled in flour, deep-fried, and then pan-fried together with ginger and garlic. When you finally plate it up, the crab seems to be lying on gold.

introduced.how: kitchen owner offering recipe and kitchen use
introduced.name: Huai'an
introduced.quote: Huai'an: Hello, how may I help you?

introduced.how: merchant offering cart ride revealed as bandit
introduced.name: Tyler
introduced.quote: Tyler: Oh, my brothers and I are all merchants. We just finished doing business in Liyue, and we're preparing to head back to Mondstadt.

introduced.how: route connecting Mondstadt and Liyue
introduced.name: Stone Gate
introduced.quote: Now having had their full, Mona tells them to head north to the Stone Gate, as it is the route connecting both Mondstadt and Liyue.

introduced.how: slimes guarding buried box
introduced.name: Dendro Slimes
introduced.quote: Traveler: This has to be the work of Dendro Slimes.

introduced.how: only skill Alice taught Klee
introduced.name: Jumpy Dumpties
introduced.quote: Klee: Mystical... arts? I... don't get it. Mommy only taught me to make Jumpy Dumpties.

introduced.how: Klee's mother skilled in many mystical fields
introduced.name: Alice
introduced.quote: Mona: Yes. As well-versed in astrology as she was, my master knew only astrology. Alice, on the other hand, was skilled in a great many other mystical fields.

introduced.how: guild offering commissions for house help
introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.quote: Mona: The Adventurers' Guild? Ah, right, you can do commissions for them in exchange for... you know what I mean, don't you?

introduced.how: sealed house owner offering cheap rent
introduced.name: Goth
introduced.quote: Goth: Oh, I'm Goth, the owner of this house. I passed by the Adventurers' Guild a while back, and Katheryne told me about the matter.

introduced.how: destination city beyond Stone Gate
introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Mona: If we travel north from here, we should reach the , and from there, we will be within the boundaries of Mondstadt.

introduced.how: Adventurers' Guild member revealing sealed house
introduced.name: Katheryne
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.how: seal on house dispelled by astrology
introduced.name: Hydro seal
introduced.quote: Bringing Mona to the house, she dispels the Hydro seal with her astrology.

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Paimon: You remember? The stuff we helped Master Diluc make.

assumed.name: Klee
assumed.quote: Klee: Wow, it's you, Honorary Knight! And Paimon too! You're back!

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Paimon: Doesn't that sound like... Lisa?

assumed.name: The Crisis Deepens
assumed.quote: (If the player has already met Mona during The Crisis Deepens)

assumed.name: Knight of Favonius
assumed.quote: Mona: From the present station and movement of the stars... I see, so that successor is a young... female... Knight of Favonius.

assumed.name: Liyue Harbor
assumed.quote: (After leaving Liyue Harbor)

assumed.name: Archon
assumed.quote: Mona: Picking up people on the road who appear vulnerable robbing them blind once they've gotten on the cart, and then taking them to some archon-forsaken place — is that your deal?

threads.claim: The Traveler's fate appears as impenetrable fog to Teyvat's astrology.
threads.quote: Mona: Anything related to you becomes like a fog that even I cannot penetrate.

threads.claim: Mona's master made a 50-year agreement that requires retrieving a box from Mondstadt.
threads.quote: Mona: It was part of an agreement she made with a friend 50 years ago. But she isn't as spry as she used to be, so it's now up to me.

threads.claim: The box contained only the master's childhood diary, not mystical knowledge.
threads.quote: Mona: T—This... So this book, this diary... is that hag's... It's her diary from 50 years ago?!

threads.claim: Alice's successor inherited her blood but not her mystical knowledge.
threads.quote: Mona: Yes. It seems she has inherited the blood, but not the knowledge... what a miscalculation. There can be no contest like this.

threads.claim: Mona promises future answers about gods and the Traveler's kin after combining knowledge.
threads.quote: Mona: Then, I will have answers for you, even regarding such distant and foggy matters as gods and kin.

threads.claim: Lies are worthless before astrology because destiny and truth are written in the stars.
threads.quote: Mona: Lies are worthless before astrology. Destiny and truth are written in the stars.

threads.claim: Mona's master threatened her if she reads her diary from 50 years ago.
threads.quote: Mona: Ah, I'm finished! No wonder... No wonder that old woman said that I should not look at it no matter what, or she'd rip me to shreds...

introduced.how: realm of souls and memories where mental strength matters
introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The Night Kingdom is a realm of souls and memories, where mental fortitude outweighs physical strength.

introduced.how: forging extracts memories via ceremony from the Ley Lines
introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Xilonen: Usually, the first step to forging an Ancient Name is performing a ceremony to extract memories from the Ley Lines.

introduced.how: device given by the Lord of the Night that records adventures
introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.quote: Paimon: Oh, yeah! You need the Pilgrim's Chronicle, right? The device the Lord of the Night gave us.

introduced.how: victory returns fighters to the land
introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.quote: Mavuika: That's right. And, as long as we win, the Ode of Resurrection will return us to this land.

introduced.how: syndrome causing hallucinations among survivors
introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
introduced.quote: Iansan: That work is pretty much done, but I've discovered a lot more people with Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome in the process.

introduced.how: power used to launch the Night War that resurrects casualties
introduced.name: Divine Throne
introduced.quote: Mavuika: I may know the cause of the dreams. At the end of the battle, I launched a special kind of Night War by using the power of the divine throne.

introduced.how: blocks other souls from the Night Kingdom to prevent abuse
introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.quote: Mavuika: No, the Night Kingdom only accepts the souls of Natlan. It's always been that way. The Ruler of Death likely wanted to prevent the Ode of Resurrection from being abused.

introduced.how: drug that helps people with hallucinations
introduced.name: Draught of Lucidity
introduced.quote: Paimon: He was the one who developed the Draught of Lucidity, a drug that can help people with hallucinations.

introduced.how: legendary Natlan hero possibly identical to Capitano
introduced.name: Thrain
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Yes, but unless he brings up his past, few are likely to make the connection between a Fatui Harbinger and Thrain, one of Natlan's legendary heroes.

introduced.how: cold decisive doctor who sacrificed himself for Natlan
introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.quote: Ororon: The records said he was cold and decisive. Like The Captain, he was formidable in battle, but the two upheld very different ideas of justice.

introduced.how: Iansan's brave Tatankasaur companion who died in battle
introduced.name: Emela
introduced.quote: Iansan: That reminds me of my saurian companion. Her name was Emela. She wasn't the sharpest Tatankasaur, but she was incredibly brave.

introduced.how: Fontaine creature with a super round belly
introduced.name: Blubberbeast
introduced.quote: Mualani: A creature from Fontaine with a super round belly... You've never seen a picture of one?

introduced.how: First of the Fatui Harbingers rank held by Capitano
introduced.name: Fatui Harbinger
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Don't tell me you haven't noticed his respect for you? The First of the Fatui Harbingers doesn't work with just anyone.

introduced.how: Ayo's mother
introduced.name: Hanwi
introduced.quote: Kachina: Oh, let me introduce you — this is Ayo's mom!

introduced.how: tribe logistics leader who died after the attack
introduced.name: Atea
introduced.quote: Mualani: Auntie Atea passed away not long after the attack on our tribe.

introduced.how: grieving saurian who barely sleeps or eats after grandparents died
introduced.name: Ayo
introduced.quote: Kachina: The whole family was really close, and now, Ayo barely sleeps or eats. All he wants to do is look for them.

introduced.how: mental disorder from Abyssal contamination after purification
introduced.name: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome
introduced.quote: Paimon: According to The Captain, it's a kind of mental disorder that results from Abyssal contamination, even after its power has been purified.

introduced.how: Traveler's forged name Tumaini meaning hope
introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Xilonen: "Tumaini"... a name surfaced from the very bottom of the river of souls. It means "hope."

introduced.how: preserved proof of Natlan adventures
introduced.name: Pilgrim's Chronicle
introduced.quote: Xilonen: The Pilgrim's Chronicle is still the most significant proof of your adventures in Natlan.

introduced.how: resurrection protection needing victory and now failing
introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.quote: Citlali: But, the closer we get to the final battle, the more worried I feel... You have an Ancient Name now, but the Ode of Resurrection only takes effect if you win.

introduced.how: soul connection point damaged and corroded by Abyss
introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.quote: Citlali: That's exactly what I'm worried about. All this time, our final foe has continued to corrode the Ley Lines from the depths of the Night Kingdom.

introduced.how: soul realm weakening and failing to accept souls
introduced.name: Night Kingdom
introduced.quote: Citlali: The Night Kingdom is getting weaker by the day, especially in its capacity to accept souls. After death, many souls fail to return to the Ley Lines.

introduced.how: Scions scout who stayed to evacuate after missing prior war
introduced.name: Vichama
introduced.quote: Vichama: Back then, I missed my chance at the Night Warden Wars. I wasn't about to let that happen twice.

introduced.how: chose Tumaini and accepted its bearer using her power
introduced.name: Lord of the Night
introduced.quote: Xilonen: It all came down to the Lord of the Night's power. This situation is the first of its kind. Heck, I doubt we'll ever get a chance like this again.

introduced.how: protected Abyssal pillars needing combat opening
introduced.name: Abyssal Pylon
introduced.quote: Atea: The Abyssal Pylons are being protected by some kind of power. They can't be destroyed right now.

introduced.how: core-like growths whose eradication stops endless monsters
introduced.name: Abyss Tumor
introduced.quote: Mavuika: I'm sure you remember the "Abyss Tumors" from the previous battle. Eradicating them was critical to stopping the endless onslaught of monsters.

introduced.how: connects Paimon consciousness to Night Kingdom
introduced.name: Sacred Flame
introduced.quote: Mavuika: The Sacred Flame is connecting us. The moment it sent us here, it made sure your consciousness could reach us.

introduced.how: soul-perceiving vessel who returns souls
introduced.name: Ororon
introduced.quote: Citlali: He has a remarkable ability to perceive souls. Even after the failed ceremony, he made it his mission to travel around Natlan and return as many souls as possible.

introduced.how: Children girl saved by Xilonen who recovered real name
introduced.name: Nepecha
introduced.quote: Nepecha: Not too long ago, you and Xilonen saved me, and helped me recover my real name.

introduced.how: Natlan story second-in-command sacrificed five hundred years ago
introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.quote: Guthred: I was his most trusted second-in-command. Five hundred years ago, we fought against the Abyss together, and I sacrificed myself during battle.

introduced.how: Mavuika sister reborn across time who sent paper frog
introduced.name: Hine
introduced.quote: Hine: Hehe, yeah. I'm sure my soul has been reborn many times by now. But, that doesn't mean "Hine" is gone.

introduced.how: Tlazolli daughter borrowing mother power in dream to heal
introduced.name: Nechca
introduced.quote: Nechca: I had a good talk with my mom in that dream, and she agreed to lend me her power. That's how I was able to help you back there.

introduced.how: Ayo grandfather who chooses to stay by Ayo
introduced.name: Cetan
introduced.quote: Xilonen: That's right, I recognize him, and the two souls next to him should be his grandparents. Kachina told me about what happened.

introduced.how: Ayo grandmother who chooses to stay by Ayo
introduced.name: Hnaska
introduced.quote: Xilonen: That's right, I recognize him, and the two souls next to him should be his grandparents. Kachina told me about what happened.

introduced.how: Gosoythoth transforms into this form during battle
introduced.name: Lord of Eroded Primal Fire
introduced.quote: (Gosoythoth emerges as the Lord of Eroded Primal Fire)

introduced.how: weapon drawn by Mavuika and the Traveler to attack Gosoythoth
introduced.name: A Thousand Blazing Suns
introduced.quote: (The Traveler and Mavuika pull out the weapon A Thousand Blazing Suns)

introduced.how: blessing received by the Traveler through the mantra of Tumaini
introduced.name: Nightsoul's Blessing
introduced.quote: the Traveler receives their Nightsoul's Blessing.

introduced.how: the Traveler's Ancient Name is Tumaini
introduced.name: Ancient Name
introduced.quote: Mavuika: ancient name, "Tumaini," will be immortalized in the history of Natlan.

introduced.how: Citlali describes her as one of the elusive shining Shades
introduced.name: Ruler of Death
introduced.quote: Citlali: According to the Lord of the Night, the Ruler of Death is one of the shining Shades, an extremely elusive figure.

introduced.how: she demands Mavuika's death as price for using her power
introduced.name: Ronova
introduced.quote: Ronova: Mavuika, as the price for using my power, I shall now bear witness to your death.

introduced.how: he offers to sacrifice himself so the souls he carries can go home
introduced.name: The Captain
introduced.quote: "The Captain": But, death... is the end I have been trying to reach all along. I have come this far to use my death to open the gates of the Ley Lines to my people.

introduced.how: technology from there modified his heart to convert souls into knowledge
introduced.name: Khaenri'ah
introduced.quote: With the help of technology from Khaenri'ah, my heart was modified to convert memories and souls from the Ley Lines into knowledge.

introduced.how: outlander Sentinel Knight who fought alongside Natlan warriors five hundred years ago
introduced.name: Thrain
introduced.quote: Luta: When I was little, my father told me about Thrain, the "Sentinel Knight," an outlander who once fought alongside the warriors of Natlan.

introduced.how: his body and soul absorbed by Thrain in a flashback
introduced.name: Guthred
introduced.quote: (Thrain reaches for Guthred's body and absorbs his soul)

introduced.how: Mavuika's sister whose memory remains in the Night Kingdom
introduced.name: Hine
introduced.quote: Mavuika: To my sister, Hine.

introduced.how: fragments are relics of Secret Source technology from the era of the Ancient Dragons
introduced.name: Ancient Moon's Remnants
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Such fragments are known as "Ancient Moon's Remnants," relics of Secret Source technology from the era of the Ancient Dragons.

introduced.how: shining figures including the Ruler of Death
introduced.name: Shades
introduced.quote: Citlali: According to the Lord of the Night, the Ruler of Death is one of the shining Shades, an extremely elusive figure.

introduced.how: Mavuika wants it changed from war selection to competition for the future
introduced.name: Pilgrimage
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Because, I want the Pilgrimage to change.

introduced.how: its effect includes moral support even when no resurrection occurs
introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.quote: Mavuika: Still, "moral support" is also an important, if under appreciated, effect of the Ode of Resurrection.

introduced.how: Captain asked the Tsaritsa to be removed from obtaining it
introduced.name: Gnosis
introduced.quote: he asked the Tsaritsa to remove him from the responsibility of obtaining the Gnosis

introduced.how: Natlan's were decimated and reconstructed, cutting them off from other nations
introduced.name: Ley Line
introduced.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night: But, at one point in time, Natlan's Ley Lines were decimated.

introduced.how: tradition for outstanding warriors after their final Pilgrimage
introduced.name: celebration ceremony
introduced.quote: Mavuika: According to tradition, we hold a celebration ceremony for our most outstanding warriors after their final Pilgrimage.

introduced.how: ancient name whose defining words trace darkness to light
introduced.name: Tumaini
introduced.quote: "Tumaini" became known by all, and everyone began reciting the words that defined its message.

introduced.how: sung together at the Stadium to send support to the Night Kingdom
introduced.name: Ode of Resurrection
introduced.quote: ...Everyone gathered at the Stadium and sang the Ode of Resurrection together to send their support to the furthest corner of the Night Kingdom...

introduced.how: Archon who created a bridge between life and death
introduced.name: Mavuika
introduced.quote: And our Archon, Mavuika, created a bridge between them.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Paimon: We just got a message from Mavuika. She says to meet her at the Speaker's Chamber tomorrow!

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: I see. If all goes well, three days should be more than enough to forge the name. You won't need to push back the plan.

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: It's less about volume, and more about mental focus. But, I get it. You're just trying to show how much you care.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: Well, if you hadn't overslept...

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: There you are!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: Amina, there's been another delivery.

assumed.name: Amina
assumed.quote: Amina: You're kidding! ANOTHER one?

assumed.name: Ajaw
assumed.quote: Ajaw: The Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw will not tolerate this stifling hut! We seek a cool place of repose. This bucket suits our taste.

assumed.name: Iansan
assumed.quote: Iansan: Hello, you guys! Sorry for the wait. We're still setting up the venue.

assumed.name: Ororon
assumed.quote: Ororon: Oh, , Archon... I swear, I've been on my best behavior recently.

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Chasca: Hello, Archon. I'm fishing.

assumed.name: Chuychu
assumed.quote: Chasca: I'll never be able to replace Chuychu, but I will do everything in my power to pull them out of their loneliness and despair.

assumed.name: Varesa
assumed.quote: Iansan: Yeah, she was tough. Varesa told me she was amazing in the final battle...

assumed.name: Huaccue
assumed.quote: Huaccue: Yes, Coach!

assumed.name: Toto
assumed.quote: Kachina: During the battle, Toto refused to leave this place. Monsters started closing in, and he got really injured... But, an amazing doctor saved his life!

assumed.name: Ayo
assumed.quote: Paimon: Ayo... Oh, right! Your saurian companion.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Once we finally defeat the Abyss, will this place go back to normal?)

assumed.name: Fatui
assumed.quote: Mavuika: It's more effective to have a focused task force, and the Speaker's Chamber can contact the Fatui directly for more doses.

assumed.name: Ley Line
assumed.quote: Traveler: (That means the Ley Lines are in an even worse state than the last time I was here.)

assumed.name: Speaker's Chamber
assumed.quote: (Enter the Speaker's Chamber)

assumed.name: Ifa
assumed.quote: Ororon: Time for me to head back, too... Oh, wait! I should stop by Ifa's place first.

assumed.name: Kinai
assumed.quote: Kinai: If we don't solve the crisis in the Night Kingdom, war will continue to ravage our nation.

assumed.name: Caipa
assumed.quote: Caipa: Archon, what is it like in the depths of the Night Kingdom? We really can't go with you?

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: "The Captain": Though our homeland has become a distant memory, the flames of war continue to rage. We have long shed the last of our blood...

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: Actually, that's something I learned from you, hehe! You've really taught me a lot.

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: Oh, it's you two. The party's over, I'm guessing...

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Citlali: Xilonen is working on the last part of your Ancient Name. It's best not to bother her when she's in the zone.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: , Paimon, you're here.

assumed.name: The Captain
assumed.quote: Traveler: That reminds me of the dream I had about The Captain...

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Paimon: ...But, it's impossible for Khaenri'ahns to enter the Night Kingdom, right?

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, yeah! Abyssal power kept surging out! If Chasca hadn't destroyed the stone, Vichama would have been consumed by the Abyss.

assumed.name: Spiritspeaker Stone
assumed.quote: Citlali: This test relies on the same principles as the Spiritspeaker Stone. I heard about what happened when you used it last time...

assumed.name: Mallko
assumed.quote: Mallko: We meet again... Remember me? I'm Mallko. We met when you came to rescue Kachina. I could barely hold onto my human form back then.

assumed.name: Bona
assumed.quote: Bona: Wow, you're as strong as ever.

assumed.name: Children of Echoes
assumed.quote: Pacal: Your bravery is like an echo through the valley, calling on us to respond in kind. The Children of Echoes offer you our blessing.

assumed.name: People of the Springs
assumed.quote: Amina: In this place where streams and waves converge, the People of the Springs gather to honor your bravery.

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: The name of "Turnfire" teaches us that everything comes at a price. We've offered generations of blood and tears to this war, and now, it's time to collect.

assumed.name: Kongamato
assumed.quote: Kongamato: From the first time we met, I sensed something special. You remind me of someone... the one who moved Burkina to their side...

assumed.name: Scions of the Canopy
assumed.quote: Paimon: Wait, you're from the Scions of the Canopy! During the battle, your tribe was...!

assumed.name: Collective of Plenty
assumed.quote: Acatl: At the end of the earth lies the primal flame. We have come from afar to offer you our land's blessing and the respect of the Collective of Plenty.

assumed.name: Mavuika
assumed.quote: Mavuika: Things are looking lively over here. How are you feeling, ?

assumed.name: Citlali
assumed.quote: Citlali: , Paimon! Finally! I was looking everywhere for you!

assumed.name: Iansan
assumed.quote: Iansan: You did it again, . Your strength is remarkable!

assumed.name: Mualani
assumed.quote: Mualani: Welcome back, great hero... I can't wait to tell your story to everyone!

assumed.name: Ororon
assumed.quote: Ororon: We should record it on a woven scroll, too. That way, your story will be preserved in my tribe for generations to come.

assumed.name: Chasca
assumed.quote: Chasca: Amazing job, . Becoming the first outlander with an ancient name definitely makes you a legend.

assumed.name: Xilonen
assumed.quote: Xilonen: The Lord of the Night was right to place her trust in you. She chose the perfect name.

assumed.name: Kachina
assumed.quote: Kachina: Th—The most important thing is that you made it back safe! Now, I don't have to worry about the rescue plan!

assumed.name: Kinich
assumed.quote: Kinich: Bravery aside, I try not to act on impulse... But, I suppose there's an exception to every rule.

assumed.name: K'uhul Ajaw
assumed.quote: Ajaw: Why does no one ask for the autograph of the Almighty Dragonlord K'uhul Ajaw!?

assumed.name: Lord of the Night
assumed.quote: Yohualtecuhtin, Lord of the Night: You who traversed the stars

assumed.name: Night Warden Wars
assumed.quote: Mavuika: In most cases, "outstanding" means warriors who earned more than twenty victories in the Night Warden Wars.

assumed.name: Abyss
assumed.quote: Paimon: Paimon knew you could do it! The Abyss is no match for you!

assumed.name: Gosoythoth
assumed.quote: (Mavuika delivers a strong punch to Gosoythoth, causing a massive explosion that knocks her back)

assumed.name: Xbalanque
assumed.quote: Paimon: Right! Xbalanque created the rules of Natlan by borrowing power from the Ruler of Death — that means he's met her before!

assumed.name: Atea
assumed.quote: Traveler: I saw Atea, Vichama, Chuychu, and all six heroes from five hundred years ago... Not to mention, I heard the messages you left for me in my ancient name.

assumed.name: Vichama

threads.claim: The Ley Lines grow worse as Abyss damage spreads through the Night Kingdom.
threads.quote: Traveler: (That means the Ley Lines are in an even worse state than the last time I was here.)

threads.claim: Souls outside the Night Kingdom's light wall exist in torment without the Lord of the Night's protection.
threads.quote: Traveler: (How long have these souls existed in torment? How much longer before it ends...?)

threads.claim: Capitano is possibly the legendary Natlan hero Thrain hiding behind a Fatui Harbinger identity.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Yes, but unless he brings up his past, few are likely to make the connection between a Fatui Harbinger and Thrain, one of Natlan's legendary heroes.

threads.claim: Guthred's soul has survived for centuries inside Capitano despite normally being impossible.
threads.quote: Ororon: But didn't he die hundreds of years ago? There's no way his soul could have survived that long...

threads.claim: The divine throne's power explains why the dead returned in dreams after the Night War.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Its great power allowed the Ode of Resurrection to bring back all casualties, independent of the time of victory, or the possession of an Ancient Name.

threads.claim: Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome causes hallucinations that need documented treatment with the Draught of Lucidity.
threads.quote: Iansan: So, I've been compiling patient records while helping them overcome the hallucinations.

threads.claim: Ororon searches catastrophe records from five hundred years ago to trace Guthred's past.
threads.quote: Ororon: After the battle, I returned to my tribe and began searching through our records of the catastrophe five hundred years ago.

threads.claim: The Traveler's Ancient Name is the first ever forged for an outlander in Natlan history.
threads.quote: Xilonen points out that they need to test it to make sure it works, as it was the first time in Natlan's history that an outlander was given an Ancient Name.

threads.claim: Traveler's Ancient Name Tumaini meaning hope is forged and accepted by the Lord of the Night.
threads.quote: Citlali: Looks like the Lord of the Night has accepted this Name and acknowledged you as its bearer... No surprise there, considering we only got this far because of her.

threads.claim: The Night Kingdom weakens so lost souls wander listlessly and fade instead of returning.
threads.quote: Citlali: Once a soul becomes lost, it can never return to the Night Kingdom. Lost souls can only wander listlessly, gradually fading from existence before disappearing entirely.

threads.claim: Abyss corrupts Ley Lines and souls from inside making rescue dangerous.
threads.quote: Xilonen: The Abyss has corrupted his soul from the inside. Even if we could send him back to the Night Kingdom, it would only make the situation worse.

threads.claim: Khaenri'ah souls appearing in the Night Kingdom hints the Captain seeks help for souls.
threads.quote: Citlali: In theory, that means Khaenri'ahn souls shouldn't be drawn to the presence of the Night Kingdom. Something strange is going on...

threads.claim: Pyro Archon's fate points toward death and resurrection depends on winning final battle.
threads.quote: Citlali: And, the Pyro Archon's fate... is pointing toward "death."

threads.claim: Natlan's tribes unite a generations-long struggle into the final shared battle.
threads.quote: Mavuika: We will claim victory! In Natlan, no one fights alone!

threads.claim: Citlali returns some souls like Vichama yet cannot save all faded souls.
threads.quote: Citlali: Phew... Looks like this method worked on you.

threads.claim: Cleansing the Night Kingdom of Abyss allows the Pyro Archon to restore the Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Xilonen: Once all traces of Abyssal power are removed from the Night Kingdom, the Pyro Archon will restore the Ley Lines — that's the final step of her plan.

threads.claim: Using the Ruler of Death's power demands death in return as a rule.
threads.quote: Citlali: The moment Mavuika used the Ruler of Death's power, death was demanded in return — not necessarily as repayment for her aid, but as a "rule."

threads.claim: The Lord of the Night lacks power to restore the Night Kingdom alone.
threads.quote: Mavuika: But, the architect of the Night Kingdom is near her end. She lacks the power for such a task.

threads.claim: The Captain challenges the Ruler of Death to forsake her rules or face a paradox.
threads.quote: "The Captain": Forsake one of your rules — the choice is yours.

threads.claim: The Captain carries many souls in his heart that the Ley Lines would not accept.
threads.quote: The Ley Lines will not accept them.

threads.claim: The Pilgrimage will become competition rather than war.
threads.quote: Mavuika: There will be no war, only competition — one fueled by our dreams for the future rather than a desperate struggle for survival.

threads.claim: Ancient Moon's Remnants and the Doctor's stronghold in Nod-Krai hint at a larger project.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Ancient Moon's Remnants, The Doctor, a mysterious power... The project that connects all three must be ambitious indeed.

threads.claim: The Captain asked to be removed from obtaining the Gnosis and the Tsaritsa may send a replacement.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Perhaps a replacement Harbinger will be sent here soon. I'll make sure to be prepared.

threads.claim: The Heavenly Principles and Shades punish any attempt to harness the Abyss.
threads.quote: Mavuika: Any attempt by humanity to harness the power of the Abyss is met with swift punishment. The Heavenly Principles and the Shades show no mercy in that regard.

threads.claim: The Traveler recites the mantra of Tumaini and is fully accepted by Natlan's Ley Lines.
threads.quote: Paimon: That's the final element of your ancient name, right? That means you've been completely accepted by Natlan's Ley Lines!

threads.claim: The Ode of Resurrection did not resurrect anyone but provided moral support.
threads.quote: Mavuika: The Ode of Resurrection didn't take effect at all.

threads.claim: The people of Khaenri'ah were cursed over the Five Sinners' exploitation of Abyssal power.
threads.quote: "The Captain": But, most of us were innocent. Most of us knew nothing of the Five Sinners' exploitation of Abyssal power... myself included.

threads.claim: The Voice in the Void says the lives of Descenders are more valuable than imagined.
threads.quote: Voice in the Void: The lives of the Descenders are more valuable than you can imagine.

threads.claim: The Captain's fusion grants the Lord of the Night eternal life.
threads.quote: Citlali: In the end, he used that immortality to his advantage and granted the Lord of the Night eternal life by fusing his existence with hers.

threads.claim: Tumaini's defining words say light followed darkness only after someone set themselves aflame.
threads.quote: "Until someone set themselves aflame."

threads.claim: Mavuika created a bridge between the side that fought for life and the Captain who fought for death.
threads.quote: And our Archon, Mavuika, created a bridge between them.

threads.claim: Natlan has entered a new era of peace now that the dust has settled.
threads.quote: Anyway, the dust has now settled, and Natlan has entered a new era of peace.

threads.quote: ...Everyone gathered at the Stadium and sang the Ode of Resurrection together to send their support to the furthest corner of the Night Kingdom...

introduced.how: join for adventure and saving Mondstadt
introduced.name: Adventurers' Guild
introduced.quote: Cyrus: Roll up, youngsters, join the Adventurers' Guild today! In this time of great upheaval, we must rally together, take on the dragon, and save our great city of Mondstadt!

introduced.how: Mondstadt was ruled over by a tyrant
introduced.name: Ancient Mondstadt tyranny
introduced.quote: Venti: It was ruled over by a tyrant.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Amber: You just returned yesterday, right? Jean got back first, and she told us all about your heroic deeds.

assumed.name: Jean
assumed.quote: Jean: I am with you, Honorary Knight!

assumed.name: Diluc
assumed.quote: Diluc: Do not underestimate them just because I have beaten one of them before.

assumed.name: Kaeya
assumed.quote: Amber: I agree. He sets a terrible example for someone who's Cavalry Captain.

assumed.name: Lisa
assumed.quote: Otto: Now I have to submit a full damage report on the disaster to Lisa.

assumed.name: Albedo
assumed.quote: Guy: We're lucky Albedo stayed in the city during the crisis. Our defenses were all the stronger for it.

assumed.name: The Legend of Vennessa
assumed.quote: Venti: Hopefully, this song will be sung for years to come by the people of Mondstadt, just like The Legend of Vennessa.

assumed.name: Teardrop Crystal
assumed.quote: Traveler: Is it because I purified the Teardrop Crystal?

assumed.name: dragon tears
assumed.quote: Paimon: So says the person that made zero effort to search for the dragon tears and drank in the tavern all day!

assumed.name: Sticky Honey Roast
assumed.quote: Amber: Hmm... I promised to take you out for some Sticky Honey Roast, didn't I? Before everyone got caught up in the Stormterror crisis.

assumed.name: Cat's Tail
assumed.quote: Amber: I mean, it's not like he would've just sat the whole thing out at the Cat's Tail, right? ...Right?

assumed.name: Windrise
assumed.quote: (It's probably due to the connection between Windrise and the Anemo Archon. Master Jean has figured it out as well, but we can't tell Barbara...)

threads.claim: The Abyss Order corrupted Dvalin with cursed blood clots, and the Traveler purified him to free him.
threads.quote: Venti: The Abyss Order must have cursed the wounds. That's what's corrupting Dvalin's mind.

threads.claim: The Abyss Order is united under a single leader who devised the plot to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Yes. And it was this very leader who devised the plot to turn Dvalin into a weapon of war.

threads.claim: Venti teaches that Dvalin must choose freedom himself because freedom demanded by an archon is no freedom at all.
threads.quote: Venti: Freedom, if demanded of you by an archon, is really no freedom at all.

threads.claim: A certain catastrophe five hundred years ago severed the Tsaritsa's ties with Venti and changed her completely.
threads.quote: Venti: You see, a certain catastrophe happened five hundred years ago, and after that, she cut off all ties with me.

threads.claim: Signora stole Venti's Gnosis from his chest and fled with her Fatui subordinates before the Knights arrived.
threads.quote: (Signora forcefully grabs Venti's Gnosis from his chest)

threads.claim: The Traveler must travel to meet The Seven, starting with the Geo Archon in Liyue at the yearly Rite of Descension.
threads.quote: Venti: ...In any case, this year's Rite of Descension is soon to begin. If you miss it, you'll just have to wait another year.

threads.claim: The voice the Traveler heard previously was Venti's when he granted Anemo power.
threads.quote: Traveler: I knew it! It was YOUR voice I heard.

threads.claim: Mondstadt was once ruled by a tyrant before its freedom, a story Venti refuses to tell for now.
threads.quote: Venti: Anyway... I'll sing you that story when we have a chance in the future.

threads.claim: Before Venti became an archon, a friend taught him the meaning of freedom.
threads.quote: Venti: Before I became an archon, I too was taught the meaning of freedom in this way by a friend.

threads.claim: Vision wielders called allogenes can attain godhood and ascend to Celestia.
threads.quote: Venti: As I said before, Vision wielders are known as allogenes and may ascend to Celestia.

introduced.how: first Dendro Archon who died in the cataclysm
introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.quote: The two learn that there have been two Dendro Archons: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, who died during the cataclysm, and Lesser Lord Kusanali, the current Archon.

introduced.how: current Dendro Archon living in the Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali was discovered after Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's death and brought back to Sumeru City, where she now lives in the Sanctuary of Surasthana.

introduced.how: trainee Forest Ranger apprenticed to Tighnari
introduced.name: Collei
introduced.quote: Collei: My name is Collei. I'm a Trainee Forest Ranger. My master and I found you passed out during our patrol, so we brought you here.

introduced.how: Forest Watcher chief over Gandharva Ville rangers
introduced.name: Tighnari
introduced.quote: Collei: Oh, this is my master, Forest Watcher Tighnari. He is chief officer over all the rangers here in Gandharva Ville.

introduced.how: Fatui Harbinger whose experiments suppressed Eleazar but traumatized Collei
introduced.name: Il Dottore
introduced.quote: Her symptoms were once successfully suppressed by Dottore, one of the Eleven Fatui Harbingers, but the agonizing experiments she was subjected to traumatized her and made her touch-averse.

introduced.how: follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali seeking to revive Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.name: Dunyarzad
introduced.quote: The two are approached by a follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali's named Dunyarzad.

introduced.how: follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali who will perform Dance of Sabzeruz
introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.quote: She takes the group to meet Nilou, another follower of Lesser Lord Kusanali's who will perform the Dance of Sabzeruz, the centerpiece of the event.

introduced.how: Akademiya man investigating the stolen Knowledge Capsule
introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.quote: They witness a dispute between members of Ayn Al-Ahmar and a man from the Akademiya named Alhaitham, which ends with the two parties agreeing to fight in a few days.

introduced.how: merchant who sells wares beyond Akasha and avoids Akademiya customers
introduced.name: Dori
introduced.quote: To become customers of Dori, a shrewd merchant who refuses to do business with anyone affiliated with the Akademiya due to the nature of her wares.

introduced.how: scholar-built rainforest rest stop now a Forest Rangers base
introduced.name: Gandharva Ville
introduced.quote: ???: This is Gandharva Ville. It was originally built by scholars from Sumeru as a place to rest in the rainforest.

introduced.how: port where extremist Eremite groups spread King Deshret revival rumors
introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.quote: At Port Ormos, the Traveler and Paimon learn that some extremist Eremite groups, including one known as Ayn Al-Ahmar, are spreading rumors

introduced.how: rangers based in Gandharva Ville who patrol and assist travelers
introduced.name: Forest Rangers
introduced.quote: Now it's mainly used by the Forest Rangers as a base of operations.

introduced.how: Sumeru scholarly organization whose sages recruit Tighnari
introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.quote: Collei: Well, anyway, because Master does a lot of research on plants, sages from the Akademiya have written him many times, inviting him to take up an official position there.

introduced.how: organization that lied about a cure and took Collei for experiments
introduced.name: Fatui
introduced.quote: She handed Collei over to an organization known as the Fatui after one of their members lied and said they had a cure.

introduced.how: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata familiars who taught Tighnari ancestors about Irminsul
introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.quote: However, not even the Aranara, Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's familiars who informed Tighnari's ancestors of all of this, know how to cure Irminsul

introduced.how: endemic Sumeru disease consigning the afflicted to slow agonizing death
introduced.name: Eleazar
introduced.quote: she was born with Eleazar, a disease endemic to Sumeru which consigns the afflicted to a slow and agonizing death.

introduced.how: rainforest anomaly that withers vegetation and harms wildlife and people
introduced.name: The Withering
introduced.quote: Amir: There's a unique type of anomaly that occurs in the Sumeru rainforest. It's called "The Withering."

introduced.how: deep world tree whose Ley Lines roots absorb world memories
introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.quote: Tighnari: Irminsul is a tree located deep beneath the surface.

introduced.how: Irminsul roots that funnel world memories into Irminsul
introduced.name: Ley Lines
introduced.quote: Tighnari: Ley Lines continually absorb the memories of this world, which are then funneled into Irminsul, allowing it to collect knowledge and wisdom from ancient times to present day.

introduced.how: incense scholars use while meditating to enter deep rumination
introduced.name: Spirit Borneol
introduced.quote: While meditating, they use a certain incense known as Spirit Borneol to help calm their minds as they enter a state of deep rumination.

introduced.how: device granting access to Sumeru knowledge-granting Akasha System
introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.quote: At the entrance to Sumeru City, a new policy grants the Traveler and Paimon each an Akasha Terminal, a device used to access Sumeru's knowledge-granting Akasha System.

introduced.how: relic for obtaining knowledge beyond Akasha limitations
introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: He tells them that the missing item is a Knowledge Capsule, used to obtain knowledge beyond the Akasha's limitations

introduced.how: obscure birthday celebration of Lesser Lord Kusanali Dunyarzad wants to revive
introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad hopes to revive the Sabzeruz Festival, an obscure celebration of Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday.

introduced.how: long-deceased desert god believed betrayed for control of Sumeru
introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.quote: the long-deceased King Deshret — a god whom they believe Greater Lord Rukkhadevata betrayed to gain control of Sumeru — will soon revive.

introduced.how: starving researcher who can see Aranara and reach Irminsul
introduced.name: Haypasia
introduced.quote: Haypasia: Uh, ughhh... So hungry... *cough* Need... water...

introduced.how: timid dream-forcing creatures linked to Dendro Archon
introduced.name: Aranara
introduced.quote: Traveler: It's because the Aranara are very timid creatures.

introduced.how: root of Dendro Archon's power holding divine knowledge
introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.quote: Haypasia: Since the root of the Dendro Archon's power lies within Irminsul, we can occasionally tap into her powers to peer into the depths of the earth.

introduced.how: incense of Rukkhadevata plants aiding Irminsul contact
introduced.name: Spirit Borneol
introduced.quote: Haypasia: The ingredients used to make Spirit Borneol primarily consist of plants created by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

introduced.how: departed God of Wisdom who founded Sumeru and made Akasha
introduced.name: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata
introduced.quote: Asfand: Just take the Akademiya for example. They're the ones who truly rule Sumeru. Although they believe in gods, most of 'em only care for the late Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

introduced.how: newborn deity found by sages 500 years ago now hidden
introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.quote: Paimon: Five hundred years ago, the sages found a newly born deity from within some scorched ruins... The deity now resides in the Sanctuary of Surasthana...

introduced.how: treasure trove of knowledge left by Greater Lord
introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.quote: Panah: Perhaps you two have heard of the Akasha before. It's our beloved Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's lasting legacy, a treasure trove of collected knowledge.

introduced.how: leaf device giving access to Akasha knowledge
introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.quote: Panah: As long as you are within Sumeru's borders, you may use an Akasha Terminal to connect directly to the Akasha and access any knowledge you need.

introduced.how: institution ruling Sumeru through Akasha research
introduced.name: Akademiya
introduced.quote: Tighnari: It's called an Akasha Terminal. It's a tool produced by the Akademiya that utilizes the legacy of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

introduced.how: Darshan studying stars and fate
introduced.name: Rtawahist
introduced.quote: Haypasia: As a member of the Rtawahist Darshan at the Akademiya, my main area of research is the stars and their connection to the fate of living beings.

introduced.how: dangerous training stage risking madness
introduced.name: Satyavada Life
introduced.quote: Haypasia: I am currently in the stage of training known as "Satyavada Life."

introduced.how: hidden residence of Dendro Archon
introduced.name: Sanctuary of Surasthana
introduced.quote: Rohawi: All I know is that ever since Lesser Lord Kusanali returned to Sumeru, she's never left the Sanctuary of Surasthana or made a public appearance.

introduced.how: capital where Terminals work best and people ignore archon
introduced.name: Sumeru City
introduced.quote: Panah: And with that, let me officially welcome you both to Sumeru City. May the wisdom of the Dendro Archon always be your guide.

introduced.how: six Darshan leaders ruling Akademiya
introduced.name: The Six Great Sages
introduced.quote: Rohawi: Sage is the highest rank for an Akademiya researcher. Since the institution's founding, each of The Six Great Sages represent the finest mind and leader of their respective Darshan.

introduced.how: mercenary groups gathering intelligence across Sumeru
introduced.name: Eremites
introduced.quote: Katheryne: In Sumeru, the Adventurers' Guild does not serve as the vanguard of information. Rather, there are numerous active mercenary groups, collectively known as the Eremites.

introduced.how: oldest Eremite brigade guarding Sumeru City
introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.quote: Katheryne: An Eremite brigade called the Corps of Thirty is in charge of Sumeru City's defenses.

introduced.how: headquarters of Corps of Thirty
introduced.name: Citadel of Regzar
introduced.quote: Katheryne: If you'd like to get in contact with him, you can find him at the Corps of Thirty's headquarters, the Citadel of Regzar.

introduced.how: retired Corps of Thirty adviser linked to Guild
introduced.name: Asfand
introduced.quote: Katheryne: Asfand, an adviser with the Corps of Thirty, maintains good relations with the Adventurers' Guild.

introduced.how: Corps of Thirty officer issuing Terminals at gate
introduced.name: Panah
introduced.quote: Panah: One moment please, you two. It appears this is your first time visiting Sumeru City.

introduced.how: sick follower who believes Kusanali befriended her
introduced.name: Dunyarzad
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: Oh, I'm sorry, I forgot to introduce myself. I am Dunyarzad, one of Lesser Lord Kusanali's faithful followers!

introduced.how: bodyguard who agrees to cover for Dunyarzad
introduced.name: Dehya
introduced.quote: Dehya: I'm Miss Dunyarzad's bodyguard, here to see that she returns home safe and sound.

introduced.how: birthday festival of Lesser Lord abandoned by Akademiya
introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: It is Lesser Lord Kusanali's birthday, which is the day that she was found by the sages.

introduced.how: market where Sabzeruz Festival still held
introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: I know that people over by the Grand Bazaar still hold the Sabzeruz Festival to this day. But I hadn't met any of them before, so I was never able to contribute.

introduced.how: festival friend who sends flowers to Dunyarzad
introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.quote: Dehya: Hold on. My lady, does this friend happen to be Nilou? The one who sends flowers to the estate?

introduced.how: Nilou explains its legendary origin as the Goddess of Flowers' birthday celebration for the Greater Lord
introduced.name: Sabzeruz Festival
introduced.quote: Nilou: According to legend, the Sabzeruz Festival was originally the Goddess of Flowers' birthday celebration for the Greater Lord.

introduced.how: Dunyarzad identifies it as the most important performance at the festival
introduced.name: Dance of Sabzeruz
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: She'll be dancing the Dance of Sabzeruz, the most important performance at the Sabzeruz Festival.

introduced.how: Farhad explains it offers unique festival snacks and the best performers
introduced.name: Grand Bazaar
introduced.quote: Farhad: Don't be fooled into thinking that Sumeru City has the best of everything. Some festival snacks are only offered here in the Grand Bazaar.

introduced.how: Nilou explains she danced and Padisarahs bloomed where she stepped
introduced.name: Goddess of Flowers
introduced.quote: Nilou: As she danced upon the grass, countless beautiful Padisarahs began to bloom wherever she stepped.

introduced.how: Nilou explains real Padisarahs went extinct after her death
introduced.name: Padisarah
introduced.quote: Nilou: Hehe, they symbolize the Goddess of Flowers after all. It's just a shame that all the real Padisarahs went extinct after her death.

introduced.how: Dunyarzad explains Nilou will dance the Dance of Sabzeruz at the festival
introduced.name: Nilou
introduced.quote: Dunyarzad: She'll be dancing the Dance of Sabzeruz, the most important performance at the Sabzeruz Festival.

introduced.how: Dehya explains it is the largest commercial port in Sumeru
introduced.name: Port Ormos
introduced.quote: Dehya: You two have heard of Port Ormos, haven't ya? It's the largest commercial port in all of Sumeru.

introduced.how: Asfand explains the Corps are hired mercenaries not overseen by the Akademiya
introduced.name: Corps of Thirty
introduced.quote: Asfand: The Corps of Thirty isn't officially overseen by Akademiya, but because we're hired mercs, there's still lots of sensitive intel that I can't reveal to ya.

introduced.how: Tariq explains he founded the great desert nation that was their homeland
introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.quote: Tariq: Years ago, King Deshret founded the great desert nation that was our homeland.

introduced.how: Tariq explains its members are devout believers of King Deshret
introduced.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: Tariq: As you can see, members of Ayn Al-Ahmar are devout believers of King Deshret.

introduced.how: Tariq says the Oracle's voice prophesied King Deshret's resurrection
introduced.name: Oracle
introduced.quote: Tariq: But the story doesn't end there, oh no. King Deshret isn't truly dead. The voice of the Oracle has been heard in the desert, prophesying his resurrection!

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains it is a vessel storing a fixed quantity of Canned Knowledge
introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: This is a Knowledge Capsule. To put it simply, it's a vessel that can store a fixed quantity of Canned Knowledge.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains it leaked from the Akademiya over the past century
introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Over the past century, a wide variety of Canned Knowledge has been leaked from the Akademiya.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains the Akasha heavily regulates who can access what information
introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Correct, anyone. Unlike the Akasha, which heavily regulates who can access what information, Knowledge Capsules confer their contents without any requisites.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains linking to it instantly reveals its contents
introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Anyone who links it to their personal Akasha Terminal instantly becomes privy to its contents.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains it is the root of Dendro power and source of knowledge
introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: That's because knowledge originates from Irminsul, the root of Dendro power itself.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains higher-quality capsules appear brighter through it
introduced.name: Elemental Sight
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Rumor has it that higher-quality Knowledge Capsules generally appear brighter when viewed through Elemental Sight.

introduced.how: Alhaitham explains they are the Akademiya's regulatory body handling illegal transactions
introduced.name: Matra
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: They belong to the Akademiya's regulatory body. They also handle cases of illegal Canned Knowledge transactions.

introduced.how: Alhaitham exposes Tariq's fake merchant address scam
introduced.name: Alhaitham
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: Listen to me. That address he gave you is fake — or at least, you won't find a merchant waiting for you there.

introduced.how: Alhaitham introduces her as a traveling merchant to find
introduced.name: Dori
introduced.quote: Alhaitham: I need you to find someone named Dori, a traveling merchant.

introduced.how: Kudari says Ayn Al-Ahmar sets up shop there
introduced.name: Djafar Tavern
introduced.quote: Kudari: I've heard that Ayn Al-Ahmar likes to set up shop at the Djafar Tavern.

introduced.how: Asfand explains the Akademiya convoy was robbed on its way back from Aaru Village
introduced.name: Akademiya convoy robbery
introduced.quote: Asfand: Lemme fill ya in. The Akademiya recently sent a convoy to pick up an important package from Aaru Village. Word got out, and the convoy was robbed on its way back.

introduced.how: Akademiya-controlled place with Akademiya staff
introduced.name: Wikala Funduq
introduced.quote: Wikala Funduq is under the Akademiya's control, so naturally, the Akademiya has people working here.

introduced.how: lost capsule said to grant wisdom of the gods
introduced.name: Divine Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: A short while ago, the Akademiya lost a Knowledge Capsule in the desert. It's supposedly a Divine Knowledge Capsule — use it, and you'll gain the wisdom of the gods.

introduced.how: combat-class capsule whose knowledge enters memory
introduced.name: Knowledge Capsule
introduced.quote: Hm, Swordfighting Techniques VIII... A combat-class Knowledge Capsule.

introduced.how: knowledge struggling students needed to graduate
introduced.name: Canned Knowledge
introduced.quote: You definitely weren't one of those students who needed Canned Knowledge to graduate from the Akademiya, right?

introduced.how: device monitoring physical parameters during fights
introduced.name: Akasha Terminal
introduced.quote: While you fight, we can use an Akasha Terminal to monitor your various physical parameters.

introduced.how: symbol of deity wisdom possessed by Akademiya
introduced.name: Akasha
introduced.quote: since the Akademiya possesses the Akasha, a symbol of our deity's wisdom

introduced.how: poor brigade determined to win capsule by any means
introduced.name: Ayn Al-Ahmar
introduced.quote: Yes. Ayn Al-Ahmar isn't exactly wealthy, but its members are determined to get that capsule by any means necessary.

introduced.how: deity Ayn Al-Ahmar hopes will return with capsule
introduced.name: King Deshret
introduced.quote: They adamantly believe that the Divine Knowledge Capsule contains King Deshret's power, and that he will return to this world when they obtain it.

introduced.how: leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar who bought the capsule
introduced.name: Mizri
introduced.quote: The Divine Knowledge Capsule was purchased yesterday by a certain Mizri, the leader of Ayn Al-Ahmar.

introduced.how: camera used to photograph the transaction
introduced.name: Kamera
introduced.quote: I used a Kamera to take a picture of the transaction.

introduced.how: knowledge source that drives researchers insane
introduced.name: Irminsul
introduced.quote: Oh yeah, you mean how some researchers go insane after getting knowledge from Irminsul?

introduced.how: research group where researchers went insane
introduced.name: Satyavada Life
introduced.quote: I've heard of numerous incidents of researchers in Satyavada Life going insane.

introduced.how: deity existing outside Sumeru administration
introduced.name: Lesser Lord Kusanali
introduced.quote: Lesser Lord Kusanali appears to exist outside of Sumeru's entire administration.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Paimon: And speaking of Lesser Lord Kusanali, even though we haven't heard too much about her, she doesn't seem to be the same deity who abducted your ...

assumed.name: Khaenri'ah
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Does it coincide with Khaenri'ah...?)

assumed.name: Raiden Makoto
assumed.quote: Traveler: (Sounds exactly like what happened to Raiden Makoto...)

assumed.name: Xiangling
assumed.quote: Besides, the best way to compliment a chef is to show passion for their food! Xiangling taught Paimon that.

assumed.name: Statue of The Seven
assumed.quote: Paimon: The Dendro Archon's Statue of The Seven is up there, you should try touching it like the other ones we've found on our journey.

assumed.name: Liyue
assumed.quote: Tighnari: To be honest, I hadn't realized you're that Honorary Knight from Mondstadt until Collei told me just now. I've also heard all about your deeds in Liyue and Inazuma.

assumed.name: Inazuma
assumed.quote: Tighnari: To be honest, I hadn't realized you're that Honorary Knight from Mondstadt until Collei told me just now. I've also heard all about your deeds in Liyue and Inazuma.

assumed.name: Stormterror
assumed.quote: Amber related how the Traveler and Paimon got involved with the Stormterror incident.

assumed.name: Abyss Herald
assumed.quote: The dream highlights their doubts about their journey's purpose and their relationship with their sibling, voiced through an undefeatable conjuration of the Abyss Herald they confronted in the past.

assumed.name: Abyss Herald
assumed.quote: Abyss Herald: Hahaha! Well, well, well. Looks like we meet again, Traveler!

assumed.name: Tighnari
assumed.quote: Paimon: It's okay, you can relax, Haypasia. Tighnari sent us here to bring you some food and water. Here, we have a letter that he asked us to give you.

assumed.name: Collei
assumed.quote: Traveler: We need to say goodbye to Collei.

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Oh, you're right! Katheryne! The Adventurers' Guild has its own intel network. Let's hurry and find her.

assumed.name: Amber
assumed.quote: Collei: Oh, and Traveler? If you ever see Amber again during your travels, please don't mention my illness to her, okay?

assumed.name: Eleazar
assumed.quote: Collei: Amber knows about my case of Eleazar and what's happened in my past, but I haven't told her about my condition getting worse...

assumed.name: The Withering
assumed.quote: Tighnari: Don't you worry about Collei, I'll look after her. I'll find a way to understand the relationship between The Withering and her disease.

assumed.name: Traveler's Sibling
assumed.quote: Abyss Herald: The bonds of love and family which drive you to find your sibling are utterly gone! Your journey is meaningless!

assumed.name: Adventurers' Guild
assumed.quote: Katheryne: Understood. The Adventurers' Guild is always ready to serve you. With what do you require assistance?

assumed.name: Primeval Rosin
assumed.quote: (Enter the Primeval Rosin-locked entrance)

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Dunyarzad: How much Mora do I have to pay you to become your employer, so you never listen to my parents ever again? Double... Triple? Give me some time and I'll get that much!

assumed.name: Katheryne
assumed.quote: Paimon: Huh, come to think of it, Paimon's only ever seen her behind the counter at the Adventurers' Guild... This is the first time we've ever seen her taking a break.

assumed.name: Dehya
assumed.quote: Nilou: Uh oh, but if Dehya's here, that means you got caught, right?

assumed.name: Dunyarzad's father
assumed.quote: Dehya: You might as well just accept the lift. If I let you walk, who knows how long it'll take us! And if anything happens to you, then I'd really never hear the end of it from your father.

assumed.name: Homayani family
assumed.quote: Dehya: Count me out. I've got plenty of work to do here for the Homayani family.

assumed.name: Akademiya
assumed.quote: Nilou: The Akademiya looks down on performers like us. They probably think it would be best if the theater closed down completely.

assumed.name: Mora
assumed.quote: Dunyarzad: Ah, yes... Initially, I didn't have much Mora prepared, so I had Nilou sell one of my skirts.

assumed.name: Sumeru City
assumed.quote: Dunyarzad: Oh, meet and Paimon, my two newest friends. They're visitors who just arrived at Sumeru City and are looking for information on Lesser Lord Kusanali.

threads.claim: A feminine voice urging the world to forget it appears as the Traveler sees a white tree under a red sky.
threads.quote: ...World... Forget me...

threads.claim: The Traveler's unconscious vision was a real memory inside Irminsul reached through consciousness.
threads.quote: Tighnari: When you passed out, your consciousness had connected directly with Irminsul. What you witnessed were actually real memories contained within Irminsul itself.

threads.claim: The Withering stems from a disease affecting Irminsul that no one knows how to cure.
threads.quote: The Withering, he explains, stems from a disease affecting Irminsul, a giant tree in the depths of the world which has Ley Lines for roots.

threads.claim: More Withering Zones make Eleazar cases worsen while the rainforest ecosystem declines.
threads.quote: Tighnari: And most disturbingly... as the appearances of Withering Zones have started to increase, Collei's case of Eleazar has also become more serious.

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali stays hidden in the Sanctuary while the Akademiya shows her less esteem than her predecessor.
threads.quote: The Akademiya holds Lesser Lord Kusanali in less esteem compared to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, so the new Archon's lack of presence has gone unquestioned by the people of Sumeru.

threads.claim: The red sky in the Traveler's vision may point to Khaenri'ah.
threads.quote: Traveler: (When I saw the vision, it felt as if I was standing deep underground. But the red sky... Could it have been Khaenri'ah?)

threads.claim: Adults in Sumeru cannot dream because the Sages claim Greater Lord Rukkhadevata suppressed dreams to protect people from chaos.
threads.quote: Sumeru people's inability to dream as adults — which the Sages claim is Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's way of protecting her people from the irrationality and disorderliness of dreams.

threads.claim: The Akasha cannot answer how to meet the Archon and researchers seek knowledge beyond its limits through capsules.
threads.quote: However, asking the Akasha directly or indirectly doesn't really work, nor Rohawi, Katheryne, or the Corps of Thirty advisor Asfand are able to tell them how to meet with the Archon.

threads.claim: Nilou wants a real purple Padisarah like the flower extinct after the Goddess of Flowers died.
threads.quote: Nilou expresses her wish for real Padisarahs, a vibrant purple flower which went extinct after the Goddess of Flowers died thousands of years ago.

threads.claim: Extremist Eremite groups claim the dead King Deshret will soon revive.
threads.quote: are spreading rumors that the long-deceased King Deshret — a god whom they believe Greater Lord Rukkhadevata betrayed to gain control of Sumeru — will soon revive.

threads.claim: Contact with divine knowledge in Irminsul and the Divine Knowledge Capsule drives people insane without granting true power.
threads.quote: Alhaitham compares Mizri's state to that of researchers who have gone insane after connecting to Irminsul, concluding that the Capsule grants neither divine knowledge nor power.

threads.claim: Ayn Al-Ahmar leader Mizri holds the stolen Capsule during the scheduled fight.
threads.quote: With Dori's help, they discover that Ayn Al-Ahmar's leader, Mizri, has obtained it, and plan on forcing the Eremites to give them access to the Capsule during their scheduled fight.

threads.claim: Tighnari hid the vision truth until seeing the Traveler handle the Withering proved they could be entrusted with Sumeru's fate.
threads.quote: Tighnari: Now, after seeing you in action with my own eyes, you have earned my confidence, and I no longer feel the need to hide any secrets from you.

threads.claim: Mizri repeats the World Forget me phrase first heard in the vision.
threads.quote: As he is being led away, Mizri mutters "...World ...Forget me..."

threads.claim: Haypasia trains for years to connect to Irminsul and first saw Aranara once she succeeded.
threads.quote: It took her three years to connect to Irminsul and was lauded as a genius, and it was also the day she was able to see the Aranara, such as the 'neighbor' who helped her.

threads.claim: Irminsul contains dangerous divine knowledge that researchers risk their minds to access.
threads.quote: Haypasia: Sages have said that Irminsul contains divine knowledge, and touching such knowledge without the proper preparations and abilities will only lead to one's mind caving in on itself.

threads.claim: Sumeru adults never dream and sages treat this as a blessing from the God of Wisdom.
threads.quote: Haypasia: Yes... Well, to an extent. Only children can dream in Sumeru. Adults, however, never do.

threads.claim: Aranara are envoys of the God of Wisdom with power to force dreams on people.
threads.quote: Haypasia: Heh, but what's strangest of all is that they're clearly an envoy of the God of Wisdom herself, and they have the curious power to make people dream.

threads.claim: The Akasha refuses to answer how to meet Lesser Lord Kusanali and filters answers by identity.
threads.quote: Paimon: Okay, next, let's concentrate on asking how to meet her... Huh? Paimon doesn't sense anything... Hmm, the Akasha didn't respond to Paimon's question.

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali never leaves the Sanctuary of Surasthana or makes public appearances.
threads.quote: Rohawi: All I know is that ever since Lesser Lord Kusanali returned to Sumeru, she's never left the Sanctuary of Surasthana or made a public appearance.

threads.claim: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata died and Lesser Lord Kusanali inherited her legacy as a newborn deity.
threads.quote: Asfand: In their eyes, she was the one who founded Sumeru and gifted us with the Akasha. Lesser Lord Kusanali just happened to inherit her legacy.

threads.claim: The Akademiya neglects the Sabzeruz Festival so only Grand Bazaar supporters still hold it.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: But because of the Akademiya's influence, people have gradually lost interest in the festival.

threads.claim: Dunyarzad believes a childhood voice that befriended her was the Dendro Archon.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: That voice sparked a desire for wisdom — it had to have been the Dendro Archon.

threads.claim: An Irminsul memory contains the phrase world forget me whose meaning is unknown.
threads.quote: Haypasia: Hmm... "world... forget me..." What could that possibly mean?

threads.claim: The Abyss Herald claims the Highness has forsaken the Traveler and the sibling bond is gone.
threads.quote: Abyss Herald: Highness has long since forsaken you. Your meager existence in eyes is that of an annoying bug only to be stepped upon!

threads.claim: Nilou's long-practised dream of dancing the Dance of Sabzeruz is about to become reality at the upcoming festival.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: And I can't wait to see you on the stage! You've been practicing so long already — it's almost time for your dream to become reality!

threads.claim: The stolen Akademiya item is revealed to be a Knowledge Capsule.
threads.quote: Traveler: Seems like it's a Knowledge Capsule?

threads.claim: The Akasha tightly regulates who can access what information, and Knowledge Capsules let people bypass that regulation.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: Correct, anyone. Unlike the Akasha, which heavily regulates who can access what information, Knowledge Capsules confer their contents without any requisites.

threads.claim: Ayn Al-Ahmar believes King Deshret is not truly dead and will resurrect as the Oracle prophesied.
threads.quote: Tariq: But the story doesn't end there, oh no. King Deshret isn't truly dead. The voice of the Oracle has been heard in the desert, prophesying his resurrection!

threads.claim: Ayn Al-Ahmar claims Greater Lord Rukkhadevata destroyed King Deshret's civilization.
threads.quote: Tariq: Greater Lord Rukkhadevata, yes! That shameless wretch destroyed King Deshret's civilization

threads.claim: Real Padisarahs went extinct after the Goddess of Flowers died, and the Greater Lord could never truly replicate their purple.
threads.quote: Dunyarzad: Yeah. The Greater Lord brought forth Padisarahs in memory of the Goddess of Flowers, but she ultimately could never truly replicate that beautiful purple.

threads.claim: The Sabzeruz Festival dance was originally performed to honour the Greater Lord but is now performed for the Lesser Lord.
threads.quote: Shrimati: As a child, I even asked my grandmother why we performed the dance for the Lesser Lord when it was originally done to honor the Greater Lord.

threads.claim: The Akademiya looks down on Grand Bazaar performers and would let the theater close.
threads.quote: Nilou: The Akademiya looks down on performers like us. They probably think it would be best if the theater closed down completely.

threads.claim: Extremist Eremites in Port Ormos preach retaking Sumeru for King Deshret and are growing into a headache for the Corps of Thirty.
threads.quote: Dehya: There are even some extremists who go around shouting slogans like "Retake Sumeru for King Deshret!" Word is that more and more are joining their movement.

threads.claim: Alhaitham will meet the Ayn Al-Ahmar at the pier in front of the Pharos Lighthouse a week from today.
threads.quote: Tariq: Okay then, if you really have a death wish, let's meet a week from today... The pier in front of the Pharos Lighthouse, four o'clock in the afternoon, sharp.

threads.claim: Alhaitham's condition for further help is that the Traveler become Dori's trusted customer by buying high-quality Knowledge Capsules.
threads.quote: Alhaitham: Become one of Dori's customers and earn her trust. This is my condition for further collaboration.

threads.claim: Katheryne's unusually informal break-time behaviour makes Paimon notice something really different about her today.
threads.quote: Paimon: Hmm, there's something really different about Katheryne today...

threads.claim: Dunyarzad is feeling worn out after the outing and needs to rest.
threads.quote: Dehya: My lady is feeling a little worn out at the moment. Nilou's found a place for her to rest.

threads.claim: The Divine Knowledge Capsule does not grant divine wisdom and instead drives Mizri insane.
threads.quote: Possessing it doesn't grant you divine wisdom or power.

threads.claim: Knowledge from Irminsul can drive researchers insane, as the capsule did to Mizri.
threads.quote: Oh yeah, you mean how some researchers go insane after getting knowledge from Irminsul?

threads.claim: Mizri's words 'World, forget me' repeat something heard at Irminsul and stay unexplained.
threads.quote: Did you hear what he said? "World... forget me..." What could that possibly mean?

threads.claim: Lesser Lord Kusanali stays outside Sumeru administration, so most scholars would not know she exists.
threads.quote: Most of the time, you wouldn't know she exists at all.

threads.claim: Ayn Al-Ahmar believes the capsule holds King Deshret's power and will bring his return.
threads.quote: They adamantly believe that the Divine Knowledge Capsule contains King Deshret's power, and that he will return to this world when they obtain it.

threads.claim: Alhaitham deflects motive questions by blaming researchers' actions on curiosity.
threads.quote: When you are unable to understand a researcher's actions, most cases can be attributed to curiosity.

threads.claim: The Akademiya's Akasha symbol of wisdom has replaced any desire to contact the deity directly.
threads.quote: since the Akademiya possesses the Akasha, a symbol of our deity's wisdom, scholars have no reason to desire to make contact with the deity herself anyway...
