introduced.quote: Lisa: A mysterious archipelago enveloped by storms and dense fog, belonging to no nation.

introduced.how: former name of the Golden Apple Archipelago
introduced.name: Haar Islands
introduced.quote: Venti: So now they're called the Golden Apple Archipelago, huh? They used to be known as the Haar Islands.

introduced.how: fog-dissipating beacon-like device similar to player's waypoints
introduced.name: Portable Waypoints
introduced.quote: Paimon: Don't you think it looks familiar, ? Pretty similar to the Portable Waypoints we've used before.

introduced.how: material for crafting Portable Waypoints and light source
introduced.name: Luminescent Spine
introduced.quote: Paimon: Crafting Portable Waypoints requires Luminescent Spines, so they can also function as a source of light.

introduced.how: bard whose lyre can call forth creatures
introduced.name: Venti
introduced.quote: Jean: He's a legendary bard of exceptional musical talent who can use his lyre to call forth all manner of creatures.

introduced.how: unresponsive machine in Inazuman clothing on platform
introduced.name: Humanoid machine
introduced.quote: Jean: It's some kind of humanoid machine. No response... It must be damaged.

introduced.how: theorized structure that raises islands from sea
introduced.name: Mechanical framework
introduced.quote: Jean: With the entire archipelago situated on a mechanical framework, it could be activated to raise each island from beneath the water.

introduced.how: journal describing noon fog gap and wind timing
introduced.name: Illegible Notes
introduced.quote: Paimon: It says that there will be a gap in the fog around the northern island at noon...

introduced.how: mysterious signer of personalized luring letters
introduced.name: Dodo-King
introduced.quote: Diluc: They were all signed, Dodo-King.

introduced.how: deserted island destination named in luring letter
introduced.name: Golden Apple Archipelago/1.6
introduced.quote: Albedo: My letter was very simple: "I have Klee. If you wish to see her, come to the Golden Apple Archipelago."

introduced.how: traditional Mondstadt festival throwing harpasta for the Anemo Archon
introduced.name: Ludi Harpastum
introduced.quote: Barbara: You're probably familiar already but, Ludi Harpastum is a traditional Mondstadt festival.

introduced.how: handmade harpastum Barbara made for Klee
introduced.name: harpastum
introduced.quote: Barbara: Klee loves Ludi Harpastum. Still, it's not quite here yet... so I made her that special harpastum.

introduced.how: giant human-form machine with autonomous combat ability
introduced.name: Inazuman machine
introduced.quote: Albedo: Our previous conjecture was correct. This giant in Inazuman attire is a machine modeled on the human form.

introduced.how: Inazuman closure making the machine arrival unexplained
introduced.name: Sakoku Decree
introduced.quote: Jean: But... as far as I know, Inazuma is still under the Sakoku Decree. How could such a massive piece of offensive weaponry have found its way here?

introduced.how: visitors who once lived on the islands then left leaving remnants
introduced.name: former inhabitants of the archipelago
introduced.quote: Albedo: I would go so far as to infer that this archipelago once held a human population. They were most likely visitors from elsewhere — not indigenous to the islands.

introduced.how: people who fled Inazuma by boat and drifted here after trouble at sea
introduced.name: Inazuman shipwreck survivors
introduced.quote: Paimon: "We have no idea where we are, but it looks like we've left Inazuma far behind. Ha, I wish I could see the looks on the faces of those Shogunate lackeys!"

introduced.how: Inazuman authorities the shipwreck survivors fled from
introduced.name: Shogunate
introduced.quote: Paimon: "We have no idea where we are, but it looks like we've left Inazuma far behind. Ha, I wish I could see the looks on the faces of those Shogunate lackeys!"

introduced.how: southwestern isle shield activated by three colored installations
introduced.name: energy shield
introduced.quote: Kaeya: It would appear that these three installations are the keys to activating the energy shield.

introduced.how: ocean fish guarding three colored keys and drawn by crystals
introduced.name: greedy spirit fish
introduced.quote: Jean: I believe that this "greedy spirit" is most likely an ocean-dwelling fish. If the crystals do attract it to us, then we're a step closer to obtaining our fish scales.

introduced.how: red blue and yellow crystals dropped by the machine
introduced.name: three crystals
introduced.quote: Barbara: Light red like flower petals, light blue like ocean waves, light yellow like autumn leaves...

introduced.how: Klee's mother and enigmatic near-omnipotent sorceress creator of island gifts
introduced.name: Alice
introduced.quote: Alice: Because Dodo-King is me, your mother, Alice!

introduced.how: Alice's alias posing as overlord of the Dodo Clan
introduced.name: Dodo-King
introduced.quote: Dodo-King: You dare face me, the overlord of the Dodo Clan, Dodo-King!? Such glorious courage!

introduced.how: Fictitious clan invented for Dodo-King persona
introduced.name: Dodo Clan
introduced.quote: Dodo-King: You dare face me, the overlord of the Dodo Clan, Dodo-King!? Such glorious courage!

introduced.how: Alice's remote speaking device playing her recording
introduced.name: Alice Phonograph
introduced.quote: The speaking device on the platform before you is none other than my personal creation, the Alice Phonograph!

introduced.how: Travel guide written by Alice
introduced.name: Teyvat Travel Guide
introduced.quote: Paimon: Wait! Alice? The person who wrote the Teyvat Travel Guide!?

introduced.how: Wandering scholar researcher who deciphers murals
introduced.name: Sayid
introduced.quote: Sayid: Haha, I suppose I count. Strictly speaking, I am a "wandering scholar," but I suppose that is merely just a subset of "researcher."

introduced.how: Stone drawings recording shipwrecked inhabitants story
introduced.name: Island murals
introduced.quote: Paimon: Well, we've recorded all these murals down. If we connect them, we should be able to put the pieces together.

introduced.how: First shipwrecked group drifted to island and stayed
introduced.name: First shipwreck
introduced.quote: Sayid: After they were shipwrecked, they must have drifted to the island where you encountered the murals.

introduced.how: First group attempted to rescue second shipwrecked group
introduced.name: Rescue attempt
introduced.quote: Sayid: This should be the first batch of people attempting to rescue the second.

introduced.how: Sound-storing conch recording past family voices
introduced.name: Echoing Conch
introduced.quote: Paimon: Looks like our only chance are those conches that store sounds.

introduced.how: Family fled rising tide abandoning heirloom in chest
introduced.name: Family heirloom abandonment
introduced.quote: But the family heirloom — I'm sorry... It was a choice between that and getting everyone to safety, so I... I didn't have enough time to get it.

introduced.how: Otherworld wondrous island Alice modeled summer paradise on
introduced.name: Golden Apple Island
introduced.quote: Alice: In another world, there are tales of a wondrous island named after golden apples.

introduced.how: Alice and Klee's long-lived race
introduced.name: Longevity race
introduced.quote: Alice: Klee, just like Mom, you are of a race blessed with longevity.

introduced.how: Archipelago as natural fourth crystal
introduced.name: Summer Crystal
introduced.quote: Jean: Perhaps from Alice's perspective, this archipelago is the natural fourth crystal.

introduced.how: City whose freedom Alice values for herself and Klee
introduced.name: Mondstadt
introduced.quote: Alice: The reason why I like the city of Mondstadt is that its freedom is exactly what my daughter and I could every hope for.

threads.claim: The storm-bound former Haar Islands are located and reached with Venti and Dvalin.
threads.quote: Klee: We're here, we finally made it!

threads.claim: The real Dodo-King remains unseen after the unresponsive machine is judged not to be him.
threads.quote: Klee: This isn't Dodo-King. The real Dodo-King is somewhere else.

threads.claim: Klee must light four beacons and knock upon the trialist gate to be judged as Dodoco's family.
threads.quote: Paimon: "Unless you bring Dodoco to the Golden Apple Archipelago, light the four beacons, and knock upon the trialist's gate to accept your challenge."

threads.claim: A damaged Inazuman-clad machine and stacked stones hint at a lost human presence.
threads.quote: Jean: No, I can only guess. It looks completely out of place on this island... Look at its clothes. It appears like it came from Inazuma.

threads.claim: Murals showing people boarding a ship are recorded without known meaning.
threads.quote: Paimon: Paimon doesn't know what all this means, but let's record this mural down first.

threads.claim: A noon fog gap and noon wind allow passage to a hidden island.
threads.quote: Paimon: It says that there will be a gap in the fog around the northern island at noon...

threads.claim: Dodo-King may not exist and someone is using his name to lure the party together.
threads.quote: Diluc: I don't believe this so-called Dodo-King exists. But there is someone or something with a reason for luring us here together.

threads.claim: Each recipient received a different personalized letter tailored to lure them to the archipelago.
threads.quote: Albedo: Everyone's letter was different, and yet all of them drew us to this archipelago.

threads.claim: Kaeya's letter hints someone wants to reveal the circumstances behind his grandfather's eyepatch.
threads.quote: Kaeya: Haha, it would appear that someone came to learn of the circumstances surrounding the eyepatch that my grandfather left me.

threads.claim: Diluc's letter claims an Abyss Order stronghold lies among the deserted islands.
threads.quote: Diluc: "There is an Abyss Order stronghold among the deserted islands. Make haste."

threads.claim: An Inazuman offensive machine reached the archipelago despite Inazuma's Sakoku Decree.
threads.quote: Albedo: It seems the answer to that question disappeared with the people that used to inhabit this archipelago.

threads.claim: The archipelago once held visitors who lived there and later left, leaving only remnants.
threads.quote: Albedo: They may have spent a long time here before finding a way to return home. Since then, the island has been empty, with only a few scattered remnants of the past.

threads.claim: The damaged machine may have attacked hilichurls to protect the former inhabitants.
threads.quote: Diluc: Hmm... There is a hilichurl presence here. Perhaps this machine's indiscriminate attack is actually supposed to be targeted at hilichurls... to protect the inhabitants.

threads.claim: The thing found at sea is what the shipwreck survivors carried on their boat.
threads.quote: Paimon: Is that the thing that those people carried with them on the boat? How strange...

threads.claim: Three colored keys guarded by a strange fish are hidden on the southwestern isle.
threads.quote: Klee: "Greedy spirit, greedy spirit, you made the moon run a ring. Keys of three colors guarded by a strange fish, the secret lies here, do you dare to proceed?"

threads.claim: Placing the crystals in the sea may attract the greedy spirit fish to obtain fish scales.
threads.quote: Jean: I believe that this "greedy spirit" is most likely an ocean-dwelling fish. If the crystals do attract it to us, then we're a step closer to obtaining our fish scales.

threads.claim: The Knights try to relax on the islands but keep returning to duty to protect everyone.
threads.quote: Jean: No matter what is waiting for us down the line, I will protect everyone... especially Klee. This is my duty as the Acting Grand Master of the Knights of Favonius.

threads.claim: Klee fears Dodo-King will take Dodoco away and wonders how Dodo-King is related to Dodoco.
threads.quote: Klee: Even if he's Dodoco's, Dodoco's... uh, grandpa? Brother? Or whatever...

threads.claim: Razor's sense of smell links his letter's scent to the machine component he found.
threads.quote: Razor: Clear smell... Same as letter.

threads.claim: A riddle says Dodo-King sleeps alone on the southwestern isle and has waited too long.
threads.quote: Klee: "Mysterious Dodo-King, mysterious Dodo-King, he sleeps alone on the southwesterly isle. The bad child made him wait too long, the days grow dark, the stars are rising."

threads.claim: Dodo-King is revealed to be Alice, Klee's mother, who created the island invitation.
threads.quote: Alice: Because Dodo-King is me, your mother, Alice!

threads.claim: Alice says the freedom of Mondstadt is what she and Klee hope for and wants Klee to grow up free to do anything and go anywhere.
threads.quote: Alice: The reason why I like the city of Mondstadt is that its freedom is exactly what my daughter and I could every hope for.

threads.claim: Alice references a wondrous golden apple island in another world known by many names that inspired her summer paradise.
threads.quote: Alice: In another world, there are tales of a wondrous island named after golden apples. Known by many names, it embodies the majestic vistas conjured by human fantasy.

threads.claim: Jean suggests the archipelago is the natural fourth crystal and a Summer Crystal beside the three found crystals.
threads.quote: Jean: Perhaps from Alice's perspective, this archipelago is the natural fourth crystal.

threads.claim: Sayid reads the murals as shipwrecked people who drifted to the island stayed attempted rescue and later departed by ship.
threads.quote: Sayid: After they were shipwrecked, they must have drifted to the island where you encountered the murals.

threads.claim: The Twinning Isle mural marks a mountain with a special symbol matching the journal found by the same group.
threads.quote: Paimon: This mark... looks like the same spot that was on the journal we found.

threads.claim: Alice says she and Klee belong to a race blessed with longevity for whom time passes like a gust of wind.
threads.quote: Alice: Klee, just like Mom, you are of a race blessed with longevity. For us, time is like a gust of wind: moments come and end.

threads.claim: The Seelie that led the party to the island apparently came from Mondstadt leaving how it reached the island unexplained.
threads.quote: Paimon: So how did it get to that island, then? So many questions...

threads.claim: Conch recordings show a family fleeing rising tides to higher ground and abandoning their heirloom in a locked chest.
threads.quote: Echoing Conch: "The tides are getting higher by the year. If the water level rises much further, we will stand very little chance of survival..."

threads.claim: The unnatural weather clears after defeating the Samachurls linking the monsters to the sealed chest and weather.
threads.quote: Paimon: The weather looks fine too, now that we've beaten those monsters...

threads.claim: Alice says she watches everyone from afar as always and sneaks back to check on them without anyone noticing.
threads.quote: Alice: It's a pity that I can't meet you, but I'll be watching your every move from afar, just as always.

threads.claim: Paimon wonders whether Albedo knew from the start hinting at his close knowledge of Alice and her plans.
threads.quote: Paimon: You don't think Albedo knew from the start, do you...?

threads.claim: Sayid suggests the five vessels with differing markings may hint at a change in seawater but cannot identify what changes.
threads.quote: Sayid: Still, if this island is in the middle of the ocean, then this "something" could always be "seawater."

threads.claim: Alice tells Klee to listen to Albedo at home and says she will regularly return to see them both.
threads.quote: Alice: Oh, yes, be sure to listen to Mr. Albedo at home. Mom will regularly return to see you two.
